inspiration: Login glyph pair: a dotted globe and a key read as world plus account at a glance. Recreate the pairing with our own drawings. Refs: AAEmu.Login/Resources/Globe_icon_(the_Noun_Project_30701).svg and 6_key_copy.svg (CC BY-SA; inspiration only).
Dotted-globe construction: the globe SVG starts with small circles around a ring plus an outline path; simple vector icons of this kind scale well. Ref: the same globe SVG (first lines only).

Easy and normal instance pairs: several dungeons ship an easier folder with its own spawn files (instance_nachashgar and instance_nachashgar_easy; instance_immortal_isle and instance_immortal_isle_easy). Idea: one map, two spawn sets. Ref: AAEmu.Game/Data/Worlds/instance_nachashgar_easy/.

Multi-part instances: instance_howling_abyss and instance_howling_abyss_2 each carry their own npc, doodad and slave spawn files. Idea: a second run of an instance with its own spawn tables. Ref: AAEmu.Game/Data/Worlds/instance_howling_abyss_2/.

Terrain from 16-bit grey images: WorldConverter exports a 16-bit grayscale raw height file that GIMP or Unity can open. Idea: paint terrain as a 16-bit grey image and convert it to height. Ref: Tools/WorldConverter/README.MD.

Fast travel and respawn as data tables: Data/Portal/ holds worldgates.json, recalls.json and respawns.json. Idea: travel and respawn points defined as data, separate from code. Ref: AAEmu.Game/Data/Portal/.

Spawns split from geometry: each world folder keeps spawn files apart from map data (main_world/ has doodad, npc, slave, transfer and gimmick spawn files). Idea: designers re-tune zones without touching geometry. Ref: AAEmu.Game/Data/Worlds/main_world/.
